reviewMethod: All actual original/retake/reference triplets viewed across the complete private sheets; SeaTac r09-c05/r10-c05 and Bellevue r04-c05 additionally viewed at full1920x672 size. Reference pixels remain private.
scope: Only the29-mask aerial geometry snapshot, no new parity/native-controller/driving/hardware-FPS acceptance. Moving traffic is hidden; no later release source is substituted.

items.referenceMethod: Existing private official Esri square export for the identical atlas ID/ground size; original request bounds retained in the reference ledger.
items.observations: Exact existing technical aerial pose recaptured from the integrated structural/separator source. Conservative changed-bound coverage does not mean every change is visible from above; roofs/occlusion can conceal ground separators and under-deck structure. Native body/route clearance is separate recorded evidence, not inferred from this picture. Literal source building envelopes and the street context remain. Tall roofs project differently in the perspective ground-square view; roof equipment, landscaping, materials, tree form and current occupancy remain incomplete.
